description: dvanVis - Smart Bar and Column draws bars and columns the way finance teams read them: last year behind each bar, the target on every bar, the difference in amount and per cent, and smart insights that explain what happened in plain English. FREE FEATURES (no licence needed, no watermark) • Bars, columns, stacked, clustered and 100% stacked, lollipop and dumbbell styles • Automatic direction (IBCS): periods as columns in time order, categories as bars, largest first • Axis break when one bar dwarfs the rest, so the others stay readable • Pareto line with its 0-100% scale and the point where 80% is reached • Top N with a working Other bar: hover Other to see what it contains • Average, median and fixed reference lines, and a Total bar • Highest and lowest highlighting, colour rules and fx conditional formatting • Images or flags per category from a column of images stored in your data • Values below zero drawn as bars in their own colour • Show condition: hide the chart when a 0/1 measure is 0 • Basic headline, tooltips, drill-down, cross-filtering, scrolling, keyboard navigation and high contrast support PRO FEATURES (additional purchase may be required; one-month free trial through Microsoft AppSource) • Compare to last period: a grey bar behind each bar and the change in the labels • Target or budget: a marker or bullet band on every bar, met or missed • Variance chart: the…
